create_InferenceAPIClient: create an InferenceAPIClient for a HuggingFace model repo_id to generate text
create_InferenceAPIAsyncClient: create an InferenceAPIAsyncClient for a HuggingFace model repo_id to generate text asynchronously
generate_text: use InferenceAPIClient to generate text from a prompt and get the generated_text result
generate_stream: use InferenceAPIClient to stream token-by-token text generation responses from a prompt
check_model_support: check if a HuggingFace model repo_id is supported by text-generation-inference
